title: how a phrase about time becomes a date, or doesn't

nodes.label: the text says when something happened
nodes.note: Phrases like "three days later", "the following spring", "much later". Arrives as language, not as a number.

nodes.label: could this phrasing ever be a number?
nodes.note: Versioned fuzzy-language policy. In the router's words: vague relations stay nonmetric. Widening this file so the solver accepts more input is explicitly forbidden.

nodes.label: work out which two events it connects
nodes.note: Detect-to-admission interpretation. Turns a classified phrase into a proposed quantitative relation between two story events.

nodes.label: accept it as a real measurement, or refuse
nodes.note: Admission is a gate, not a coercion. Anything not quantitatively admissible is refused rather than approximated.

nodes.label: left as words — no number is invented
nodes.note: The refusal branch. In the router's words the relation stays nonmetric. Nothing is coerced into a number to make the solver happy, and this is the organizing idea of the whole directory.

nodes.label: write it down, append-only
nodes.note: Revision-backed persistence. Admitted temporal records are appended, never edited in place.

nodes.label: work out the actual dates
nodes.note: Deterministic difference-constraint solving over admitted edges only. No heuristics, no tie-breaking by recency or source rank.

nodes.label: say it in a sentence a person reads
nodes.note: Stable human-readable rendering of solver results.

nodes.label: "every spring" stays a rule, not a list of dates
nodes.note: Recurrence stays symbolic: expanding it eagerly is unbounded, so expansion requires an explicit finite instance query. Where this attaches to the flow, the router does not say.

nodes.label: a date remembers how it was worked out
nodes.note: Calendar derivations carry complete provenance — a derived date without its derivation chain is not a valid record. Whether this sits before or after the solver is unstated.
